prompt: Build for this brief: A cultural venue; visitors browse works, plan visits and find events. Use Plum and Mint: page #FCF9FF, text #3D2346, accent #805099, secondary surface #CDF3DF, text on accent #FFFFFF. Set headings in Oswald and reading text in Work Sans; condensed heading with open sans text. Composition: Full-width relevant image with heading overlay, visible next section, no text/media split hero. Use body 14px, heading 48px, line height 1.75, reading measure at most 48ch, gap 32px, content width at most 960px and item radius 0px. Keep letter spacing zero. At 390px use a single reading order, preserve required text and provide access to every control. Use real subject imagery when needed, not ornamental blobs. Check rendered text contrast and overflow; never call this recipe proven beautiful.
